supersedes_only: generic delegated-protocol terminal statuses from PR #313 for the 23 exact IDs enumerated here

records.exact_reason: This is only a direction-of-travel referring back to the preceding diagnosis; it contains no independently identifiable instrument, target population, competence path or causal mechanism. An ex-ante effect direction cannot be attributed to this atom without importing later measures.

records.policy: verbindliche Inhalte, klare Leistungsstandards, überprüfbare Ergebnisse
records.mechanism: Clearer curriculum/expectations and feedback can improve instructional coherence and transparency; excessive standardisation/high-stakes measurement can narrow curriculum, induce teaching-to-test and disadvantage heterogeneous learning needs.
records.distribution: Effects can differ by language background, disability/SEN, school resources and parental support.
material_risks: inequitable consequences if standards are not paired with support
records.reality_check: Learning progress across domains, inequality gaps, student wellbeing, repetition/dropout and teacher workload; test scores alone are insufficient.
records.competence: Primarily Berlin school/curriculum/quality governance, subject to constitutional/equal-treatment/inclusion requirements.

records.classification_rationale: desired learner transparency/self-assessment outcome; no independent instrument

records.policy: mandatory Kita attendance no later than age four
records.mechanism: Earlier/common participation can increase access to language, social and cognitive support and reduce unequal starting conditions.
records.noncompensation_guard: Participation quantity cannot compensate for low process quality, safeguarding or inclusion.
records.reality_check: Actual participation of previously underreached groups, process quality/staff ratios, language/development trajectories, exclusions/exemptions, family burden and later school-entry gaps.
records.required_safeguard: Capacity first; transparent exemptions/accommodations and accessible high-quality provision.

records.classification_rationale: claimed mechanism/outcome rationale child of U04-A02, not separate action

records.policy: regular language diagnostics from age three
records.mechanism: Earlier identification can trigger timely language support before school entry.
records.reality_check: Diagnostic validity across languages, referral-to-support completion, waiting time, subsequent language development and false-positive/negative rates.
records.required_safeguard: Diagnostics are useful only if linked to qualified support and do not become exclusion/selection proxies.

records.policy: Stadtteilmütter/Integrationslotsen mediate family-Kita-school relationships and strengthen parental involvement
records.mechanism: Trusted outreach can reduce information/language/institutional barriers and improve take-up/continuity of support.
records.distribution: Potentially strongest for families facing language, trust, poverty or navigation barriers.
records.reality_check: Reach of previously underreached families, successful referrals, sustained participation, family trust and child-support continuity; contact counts alone are output.

records.policy: reintroduce a binding preschool phase focused on language, numeracy and social learning
records.mechanism: Structured preparation can reduce school-entry skill gaps if high quality and targeted to actual needs.
records.reality_check: School-entry competencies, distribution gaps, attendance/reach, quality, staff burden and transition continuity.

records.classification_rationale: normative rationale for early-childhood education, not separate action
need/diagnosis for disadvantaged-area schools, not instrument

records.policy: multi-year support programme for schools in disadvantaged locations with additional funds, training and fully qualified staff
records.mechanism: Additional targeted resources and staff capacity can improve learning/support conditions where need is concentrated.
records.key_condition: Genuine additionality and needs-based allocation; funding alone is input.
material_risks: resource displacement from other high-need schools
records.reality_check: Qualified staffing/retention, instructional/support quality, learning and participation gaps, absenteeism, school climate and distribution by need over multiple years.

records.policy: distribution quotas at transition to primary school based on differing German-language proficiency within districts
records.mechanism: Reducing concentration of language-support needs may improve peer mixing and distribute support demands more evenly.
material_risks: displacement rather than improvement of school quality
records.protected_interest_guard: Language proficiency must not become an ethnic/origin proxy; transparent lawful criteria, proportionality, accommodations and appeal are material.
records.reality_check: Segregation indices, travel distances, family burden, allocation/appeal outcomes, school-level support resources and learning/integration outcomes.

records.policy: students ‘nicht deutscher Herkunft’ distributed more evenly across classes in the district
records.distinct_boundary: This is not treated as a harmless duplicate of U09-A01 because the criterion changes from language proficiency to origin.
material_risks: origin-based allocation can create unequal treatment/stigmatisation
origin is not equivalent to measured language-support need
records.required_fach_boundary: No positive effect claim without a lawful, proportionate, non-discriminatory design tied to actual educational need.
records.reality_check: Actual allocation criterion, equal-treatment/legal review, appeals, distribution/travel effects and educational outcomes.

records.policy: integrate schools more strongly into neighbourhoods, linking school, culture, neighbourhood and social services
records.mechanism: Easier referrals/shared spaces/relationships can reduce institutional fragmentation and improve access to support/community resources.
material_risks: substitution of school resources for wider social-service deficits
records.reality_check: Completed referrals/support access, participation of vulnerable groups, school staff workload, continuity of services and neighbourhood disparities; number of partnerships alone is output.

records.exact_reason: The source names a desired administrative condition but no concrete administrative change, process, resource shift, accountability rule or implementation mechanism. It is therefore not sufficiently specified for an object-level effect assessment; later concrete administrative measures must be evaluated separately.
